overview.title: Issue status
overview.subtitle: See what needs attention from SDK detection through investigation and resolution.
overview.trendTitle: New issues in the last 7 days
overview.trendDescription: Issues first created within the current result window.
overview.priorityEmpty: There are no open issues that need attention.
overview.affectedEmpty: There are no open issues to summarize.

review.title: Needs review
review.subtitle: Review new issues created by the server and decide whether to investigate.
review.empty: There are no issues waiting for review.

investigating.title: Investigating
investigating.subtitle: Track issues whose likely cause and execution evidence are under review.
investigating.empty: There are no issues under investigation.

recovery.title: Recovery review
recovery.subtitle: Review Recovery records sent by the SDK and their processing status.
recovery.pendingHint: Recovery records without a final decision
recovery.empty: No Recovery records have been received.
recovery.noticeTitle: Automatic Recovery decisions are not ready yet.
recovery.noticeDescription: The server currently stores Recovery records and keeps them scheduled for reevaluation. This page confirms that recovery signals were not lost. Automatic RESOLVED transitions will be enabled after recovery decision rules are added.

patterns.title: Repeated patterns
patterns.subtitle: Group issues that may share a cause by stable fingerprint.
patterns.empty: There are no repeated patterns to review.
patterns.fingerprintTitle: A fingerprint is evidence, not the purpose of the page.
patterns.fingerprintDescription: The list prioritizes shared causes and impact. Stable and exact fingerprint values remain available on the issue detail page.

changeImpact.title: Change impact
changeImpact.subtitle: Review problems and related runs that appeared or increased after a prompt version change.

history.title: Resolution history
history.subtitle: Review resolved or ignored issues and whether they occurred again.
history.empty: There are no resolved or ignored issues.

intake.title: Detection processing
intake.subtitle: Confirm that Issue Records sent by the SDK were received, evaluated, and decided.
intake.evaluatingHint: Records currently handled by a worker
intake.decidedHint: Issue creation, matching, or ignore decision completed
intake.deferredHint: Waiting for more context or Recovery rules
intake.delayedHint: Records still incomplete after their scheduled time
intake.unsupportedHint: Detection types without a supported decision rule
intake.empty: No Issue Records have been received.

blocked.title: Blocked issues
blocked.subtitle: Issues with at least one occurrence blocked before execution.

metrics.investigatingHint: Issues whose cause is under review

detail.title: Issue details
detail.subtitle: Review the decision evidence, execution context, occurrences, and resolution status.

metrics.sessionsHint: Unique sessions where the problem occurred

detail.judgementTitle: Why was this considered an issue?
detail.judgementDescription: The latest server evaluation and its evidence.
detail.noEvaluation: No server evaluation is connected to this issue.
detail.contextDescription: The agent, policy, prompt, and environment connected to the problem.
detail.fingerprintDescription: Stable identifies a likely shared cause. Exact separates concrete execution conditions.
detail.signalsDescription: Structured problem signals preserved by the SDK and server.
detail.noOccurrences: No occurrence records are connected to this issue.
detail.noEvaluations: No decision records are connected to this issue.
detail.statusUpdateError: The issue status could not be changed. Check your permission and the allowed status transition.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Comments, status changes, and assignee changes appear in chronological order.
activity.commentPlaceholder: Share investigation notes, reproduction results, or changes.
activity.mentionHint: Type @ to mention an organization member.
activity.commentError: The comment could not be saved. Check your permission and server connection.
activity.empty: No Activity has been recorded yet.
activity.editError: The comment could not be updated.
activity.deleteConfirm: Delete this comment? The deletion will remain in Activity.
activity.deleteError: The comment could not be deleted.

assignees.title: Assignees
assignees.description: Choose organization members responsible for investigating this issue.
assignees.empty: There are no organization members available to assign.
assignees.remaining: {count} more members are available from member settings.
assignees.error: Assignees could not be changed. Check your permission and member status.

detail.nextActionDescription: Recommended checks for the current state.

nextActionByStatus.OPEN: Review the LLM and tool flow immediately before the representative Session, then decide whether to start an investigation.
nextActionByStatus.INVESTIGATING: Compare shared risk signals with changed prompt, policy, and agent versions, then watch for recurrence after a fix.
nextActionByStatus.RESOLVED: Check whether the same stable fingerprint appears again after the resolution time.
nextActionByStatus.IGNORED: Confirm that the ignore condition still applies. Reopen the issue if new impact appears.

error.title: Issue data could not be loaded.
error.description: Check your workspace access and the server connection.

empty: There are no issues matching these conditions.
